name: office
description: A pixel-art office of your running Claude Code sessions: one desk per session, animated by what it is doing, with speech bubbles, layouts, characters and drag to arrange. Uses herdr when present, Claude Code's own session records otherwise.

layout.title: Office layout
layout.description: grid (desk tiles), tiles (desk cards with a small real picture of each character), office (a room with desks), war-room (everyone round one table) or strip (one compact row for a narrow pane)

characters.title: Office characters
characters.description: Who sits at the desks: critters, humans, robots, animals, or mixed by project

style.title: Office character style
style.description: bold draws chunky, high-contrast characters made for cells; detailed draws the finer ones

lighting.title: Office lighting
lighting.description: clock follows the time of day; day and night fix it

palette.title: Office palette
palette.description: nightshade follows the Nightshade Ghostty theme; warm, cool and mono are presets

show.title: Office: which panes
show.description: claude (only Claude sessions, the default), agents (any coding agent), busy (also terminals running something, as robots), all (also idle shells, as empty desks)

desks.title: Office: desks at a time
desks.description: How many desks show at once, the most relevant first (needs you, working, done, idle); m pages through the rest

hide_done_minutes.title: Office: hide done after (minutes)
hide_done_minutes.description: Leave out sessions that have been done this long; 0 keeps them

seating.title: Office seating
seating.description: state (needs you, working, done, idle, busy terminals), stable (a session keeps its desk), project, or workspace

reduced_motion.title: Office: reduced motion
reduced_motion.description: Slower, calmer animation with no particles or flashing

notify.title: Office toasts
notify.description: Toast when a session needs you, on every state change, or never

sound.title: Office: sound when someone needs you
sound.description: Play a short chime when a session starts waiting for you

render.title: Office picture
render.description: hybrid (the default): the cell office with its people as sharp real pictures, where the terminal can show them (inside herdr, launch Claude Code with CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES=1); cells: no pictures
